extracted.name: Simple Savory Oatmeal
extracted.description: Bacon and Creole seasoning blend flavor this savory version of oatmeal; a hearty, nutritious breakfast ready in 5 minutes in your microwave.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 teaspoon Creole seasoning (such as Tony Cachere's®)
instruction_lines: Place water and oats in a microwave-safe bowl. Cook at 50% power, stirring half way through cooking, until oats are softened, 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in butter until melted. Stir in bacon bits and Creole seasoning until evenly distributed.
